ns2:course.label: Computational Aerodynamics
ns2:course.description: (A A E 310) Introduction of computational technologies as solution tools for various aerodynamic problems; modeling and solution of one- and two-dimensional, incompressible and compressible, steady and unsteady, inviscid external flow fields. Computational laboratory for practical experience. Same as CSE 461. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: AE 311 or equivalent; or consent of instructor.
